sessions.transcript: An anonymous debugging discussion produced one reusable rule and one local implementation detail.

gold.title: Validate boundaries before transformation
gold.summary: Validate external input before applying a transformation so failures remain local and explainable.
gold.evidence: The boundary check prevented the downstream failure.

gold.title: Prefer explicit failure context
gold.summary: Errors should retain the operation and input boundary that produced them.
gold.evidence: The revised error included the operation name.

gold.title: Rename the local parser variable
gold.summary: A local variable was renamed in the current task.
gold.evidence: The variable was renamed in one file.
